DiceSpec.description: A dice specification [N]dM, N 1..10, M 2..100; d66 is refused.

Rating.description: A rating: one number for warrior and hero alike, or {warrior, hero}.

Roll.description: A chart roll: a whole number, a range "lo-hi" or a pair [lo, hi].

RuleRef.description: A rule name, or a rule definition object that the loader hoists.

Scalar.description: A string or a number read as text (the rulebook version).
